info.title: Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Routing Protocols
info.description:
Dynamic routing protocol configuration for Cisco-IOS-XE-native model. This container includes OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, RIP, ISIS, and other routing protocol configurations.

**What's included:** Complete router configuration hierarchy under /native/router

**Supported protocols:** OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, RIP, ISIS, Mobile, ODR, LISP

**Related:** See 'IP' for static routing and IP services

**YANG Model:** [Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Routing Protocols.yang](https://github.com/YangModels/yang/blob/main/vendor/cisco/xe/17181/Cisco IOS-XE Native Config - Routing Protocols.yang)
